question: An autopsy is being performed on an elderly man who died from a myocardial infarction. Biopsy of the heart is likely to reveal necrosis most similar to necrosis seen in which of the following scenarios?

options.opa: The central nervous system following a stroke
options.opb: The lung following a tuberculosis infection
options.opc: Acute pancreatitis resulting from release of enzymatically active enzymes into the pancreas
options.opd: A region of kidney where blood flow is obstructed
